decks.notes: This UW Control deck aims to control the board through cards like Dovin's Veto and Supreme Verdict, while generating card advantage with Memory Deluge and Omen of the Sea. It also utilizes cards like Stock Up and Temporary Lockdown to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The inclusion of Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion allows for additional card advantage and value by blinking permanents. The deck focuses on managing threats and taking incremental advantages until it can establish a strong win condition, whether through a planeswalker ultimate or overwhelming the opponent with card advantage.

This deck focuses on putting pressure on the opponent early with aggressive creatures and removal spells, while also disrupting their game plan with discard spells. It aims to close out the game quickly by overwhelming the opponent with efficient threats and controlling the board with removal. The deck also has a minor graveyard recursion theme to provide additional value and resilience in longer games. Overall, the strategy is to be proactive and proactive, pushing the opponent on the back foot and forcing them to react to your threats.

The main focus of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and aggressive strategy, using creatures with low mana cost and powerful abilities. The deck aims to quickly build a board presence and apply pressure to the opponent, while also maintaining resilience through cards like Skyclave Apparition and Bishop of Wings. Collected Company provides additional creature advantage and synergy, allowing the deck to consistently put threats on the battlefield. The deck's synergy between creatures and mana ramp spells enables it to quickly drop powerful angels like Righteous Valkyrie and Resplendent Angel to close out the game.

The main idea of this deck is to control the game through a combination of denial spells, card draw, and removal cards. The deck focuses on using cards like Dovin's Veto, Supreme Verdict, and Teferi, Hero of Dominaria to counter and remove opponents' threats, while also utilizing Memory Deluge and Omen of the Sea for card advantage. The inclusion of Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion adds additional value by flickering permanents for extra triggers. Overall, the deck aims to outlast opponents by maintaining control of the game until it can establish a winning board state.

This Jund aggro deck focuses on sacrificing creatures for value, utilizing cards like Cauldron Familiar, Mayhem Devil, and Witch's Oven to generate repeated triggers and deal damage to the opponent. The deck also includes disruption with Fatal Push and Claim the Firstborn to control the board. Ygra, Eater of All and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker provide additional threats and card advantage. The mana base supports the color requirements of the deck, allowing for consistent plays and aggressive pressure on the opponent.

The main focus of this red aggro deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of direct damage spells, efficient creatures, and aggressive combat tricks. By utilizing cards like Lightning Strike and Burst Lightning for removal, while also boosting creature power with Monstrous Rage and Kumano Faces Kakkazan, the deck seeks to maintain constant pressure on the opponent. Additionally, the inclusion of versatile creatures like Bonecrusher Giant and Greasewrench Goblin, along with the reach provided by Ramunap Ruins, ensures that the deck can both control the board and finish off the opponent swiftly.

The main idea of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with fast, aggressive creatures and direct damage spells. By consistently dealing damage with creatures like Emberheart Challenger and Sunspine Lynx, combined with burn spells like Burst Lightning and Monstrous Rage, the goal is to quickly deplete the opponent's life total before they have a chance to stabilize. Additional reach is provided by cards like Ramunap Ruins and Bonecrusher Giant, giving the deck multiple ways to finish off the opponent.

This aggressive red deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with a combination of low-cost creatures and direct damage spells. By utilizing cards like Emberheart Challenger, Burst Lightning, and Monstrous Rage, the deck aims to apply early pressure and finish off the opponent before they can stabilize. The inclusion of cards like Mutavault and Bonecrusher Giant provide flexibility and additional threats. With a focus on efficient creatures and burn spells, this deck aims to win through fast and relentless aggression.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on fast and aggressive plays to overwhelm the opponent quickly. Utilizing a mix of powerful creatures like Bloodtithe Harvester and Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger, along with efficient removal spells like Fatal Push and Go for the Throat, this deck aims to put pressure on the opponent from the start. The inclusion of disruptive cards like Thoughtseize and Duress also helps to control the game and disrupt the opponent's strategy. Overall, this deck is all about speed, aggression, and disruption to secure victory.

This UW Control deck focuses on controlling the game through counterspells, removal, and card advantage. The deck utilizes Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion to provide additional value. It includes cards like Dovin's Veto and Supreme Verdict for control, along with powerful planeswalkers like Teferi, Hero of Dominaria. The deck also has various utility lands like Field of Ruin and Castle Ardenvale to disrupt the opponent's mana base. Overall, the deck aims to outvalue and outlast the opponent through efficient answers and card draw.

The main goal of this deck is to quickly overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and burn spells. The key strategy involves dealing damage as quickly as possible using efficient creatures like Bonecrusher Giant and Emberheart Challenger, and finishing off the opponent with burn spells like Burst Lightning and Lightning Strike. Additionally, cards like Monstrous Rage and Kumano Faces Kakkazan provide additional damage output. The inclusion of utility lands like Mutavault and Ramunap Ruins help to ensure a consistent and aggressive game plan.

This Dimir Aggro deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's hand with Thoughtseize and controlling the board with removal spells like Fatal Push and Go for the Throat. It also utilizes evasive creatures like Mockingbird and Faerie Miscreant to chip away at the opponent's life total. Kaito, Bane of Nightmares serves as a powerful finisher, while cards like Enduring Curiosity and Moon-Circuit Hacker provide card advantage and flexibility. The deck aims to apply early pressure, disrupt the opponent's game plan, and close out the game quickly.

The focus of this red aggro deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a continuous stream of aggressive creatures and direct damage spells. The deck aims to put pressure on the opponent early in the game and maintain that pressure through efficient creatures and burn spells. With a mix of creature aggression and burn spells, the deck can quickly deplete the opponent's resources and close out the game before they have a chance to stabilize. This aggressive strategy is supported by efficient mana sources and versatile creatures that can hit hard and fast.

The main concept of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a high devotion to green strategy that focuses on aggressive plays. By using cards like Cavalier of Thorns, Kiora, Behemoth Beckoner, Old-Growth Troll, and Storm the Festival to quickly build up mana and board presence, the deck aims to control the game and push for victory. Additionally, the inclusion of cards like Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx and Lair of the Hydra further enhances the deck's ability to generate mana and reinforce its green devotion theme. This deck is designed to be fast-paced and relentless in its pursuit of victory.

This deck revolves around quickly deploying aggressive artifact creatures, beefing them up with cards like Ensoul Artifact and Shrapnel Blast, and using cards like Torch the Tower and Burst Lightning to control the board and deal direct damage to the opponent. The inclusion of Spell Pierce and Cryptic Coat helps in protecting your creatures and disrupting your opponent's game plan. With a mix of creatures with evasion and direct damage spells, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a fast, aggressive strategy while maintaining control of the battlefield.

The deck relies on a combination of disruptive creatures and powerful removal spells to maintain control in the early game. By using cards like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push to disrupt the opponent's game plan, while applying pressure with efficient creatures like Kaito, Bane of Nightmares and Moon-Circuit Hacker, the deck aims to quickly reduce the opponent's life total and secure a win. The inclusion of versatile threats like Spyglass Siren and Thousand-Faced Shadow provides additional layers of aggression and adaptability to handle a variety of opposing strategies.
